'''Howal Gode''' was a [[merchant]] from [[Whitebridge]] and a [[Darkfriend]].

==Appearance==
He was a fleshy man with soft-looking hands.

==History==
Gode is likely from Whitebridge, Andor. Rand refers to him as being a "Whitebridge merchant" by identifying his coach and dress as of the same type as the Whitebridge merchants clustered around the docks to do business when he arrived on the [[Spray]].{{ref/book|1|26}}

==Activities==
Gode tracked [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] from Whitebridge along the [[Caemlyn Road]], eventually catching up with them at the [[Dancing Cartman]] in [[Four Kings]].{{ref/book|1|32}}

Gode attempted to persuade, then threatened, Rand and Mat into submitting to him and the [[Dark One]] while they were attempting to escape from the Dancing Cartman. It was here that Rand [[channel]]ed for the third time (the first when he removed [[Bela]]'s fatigue, the second when he moved the boom on the ''[[Spray]]'') and struck down Gode along with all his Darkfriend followers.{{ref/book|1|32}} Gode was presumed dead after the encounter. When [[Ba'alzamon]] later visited Rand in a dream, the charred corpse of Gode was present and was then disintegrated by Ba'alzamon completely.{{ref/book|1|33}}

== In the television series ==
* Howal Gode does not appear in the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]], but the character of {{TVlink|Dana}} is somewhat similar to him, being a Darkfriend who attacks Rand and Mat in the {{TVlink|Four Kings Inn}} in [[Breen's Spring]].
